NO brand, logo, readable text, signage lettering, interface, printed scoring mark, watermark, border or frame. No Halloween, Hanukkah candles, chanukiah, menorah or dreidels. Maintain an entirely clear foreground tabletop and opaque full-bleed 2:3 portrait. This is an illustrative memory, not an identifiable named venue or branded event.
